goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new Site Host account and then navigate the calendar view to the previous month.

findings.instruction: Click the blue 'Sign up' button to complete the registration.
findings.title: Calendar widget content is duplicated and overlapping
findings.description: In the dashboard view after sign-up, the calendar widget content (including the 'June 2026' header, the date grid, and the 'Shortcuts' section) appears to be rendered multiple times in a stacked, overlapping manner. This creates a messy, unreadable visual state where text and grid lines are layered on top of each other.
findings.evidence: The 'AFTER' screenshot shows the calendar section with multiple instances of the 'June 2026' header and the date grid visible simultaneously, clearly indicating a rendering or layout bug.
